Subtract 24 weeks = 168 days.  
Add 6 days → total subtract 174 days.  
1501 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, so not leap).  
From 11-19-1501 back 174 days:  
October has 31 days → back to Oct 19 is 31 days earlier (Nov 19 → Oct 19).  
That’s 31 days, need 174 total → remaining 143 days before Oct 19.  
Go back through September (30), August (31), July (31), June (30) → 30+31+31+30 = 122 days, leaving 21 days.  
Back into May: May has 31 days, so May 31 to June 1 is 1 day, need 21 days before May 31 → May 10.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1501-05-10
